validated_objective: Release QIF v0.8.0 with executable Multi-Agent Judgment Memory in the Living Ledger.
scope: Add canonical judgment memory policy, memory entry, dependency disclosure, revision, retirement decision, join, and assessment entities.
Extend qif-ledger schema, verifier, example, retained negative fixtures, docs, AI guide, roadmap, changelog, runtime log, portable package, and public release.
constraints: Do not store hidden chain-of-thought, destructively delete history, treat consensus counts as truth, infer competence, surveil workers, or grant operational authority.
Retain QIF standalone use and all existing package behavior.
expected_outcomes: Every aggregate judgment remains traceable to lane-local memories, evidence, dependencies, dissent, and authority boundaries.
Revision and retirement are append-only and governed; conflicts, stale evidence, weak independence, and destructive forgetting attempts fail or route governance.
